candidates.change_summary: Replaced call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the entire contract balance to msg.sender, changing the call path and potentially its effects.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can call it and drain the contract, changing who may invoke the behavior.
Modified onlyOwner modifier to compare msg.sender to tx.origin instead of owner, altering which callers pass the check for withdrawAll.
Changed withdrawAll to call withdraw with a fixed constant value (0) instead of the contract balance, preventing any funds from being sent.
Replace transfer to send with return-value check so that failed send does not revert but reduces effective withdrawn amount (changes observable balance moved to caller).
Remove the require check so withdraw can be called by anyone, changing who can receive funds and thus observable withdraw behavior.
Change sendMoney to use transfer instead of low-level call, which will revert on failure and may alter post-call state by preventing unsuccessful external reentrancy or partial effects.

Invert the success check to ignore call failures instead of reverting, allowing function to complete even if the external call failed and thus preserving state changes that follow the call in callers.
Modify onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove the require), so sendMoney can be invoked by non-owners and thereby change observable outcomes when called by different addresses.
